The following municipel districts which have
not as yet existed for four years as of June 30,
1968, are hereby given their tentative classifi-
as indicated herein below, effective as of
the dates of their corporate existence on the basis
or their annual revenues during the fiscal year
following their organization:
NUEVA VIZCAYA
Dinalongan

By operation of the provisions of Section two
of Republic Act Numbered fifteen hundred and fif-
teen, the following first class municipal districts,
each having realized an average annual revenues of
more than four thousand pesos during the four con-
secutive fiscal vears ended June 30
1968
hereby declared and considered as-fifth class
(equivalent to seventh class pursuant to Republic
Act No. 2368) municipalities effective as of July
1, 1968:
Sta. Praxedes
Gregorio del Pilar
LANAO DEL NORTE
Pantao-Ragat
MISAMIS OCCIDENTAL
Concepcion
NUEVA VIZCAYA
219
Patnunugan
The present elective municipal district offi-
cials shall continue as such officials of the newly
declared municipalities until their successors
shall have been elected during the next general
elections for local officials and shall have qua-
Done in the City of Manila, this 23rd day of
in the year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred
and sixty-nine.
(SGD.) FERDINAND E. MARCOS
President of the Philippines
By the Fresident:
(SGD.) RAFAEL M. SALAS
